<body lang=EN-US style='tab-interval:36.0pt'>

<div class=Section1>

<p class=MsoPlainText align=center style='margin:0cm;margin-bottom:.0001pt;
text-align:center'><b><span style='font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ROYAL
WESTERN INDIA TURF CLUB, LTD.</span></b></p>

<p class=MsoPlainText align=center style='margin:0cm;margin-bottom:.0001pt;
text-align:center'><span class=GramE><b><span style='font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'>PUNE MEETING 2026, FIRST DAY, FRIDAY, 17TH JULY, 2026.</span></b></span></p>

<p class=MsoPlainText align=center style='margin:0cm;margin-bottom:.0001pt;
text-align:center'><b><span style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><b><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> (PENETROMETER:
4.4 (LONGCHAMP METHOD); GOING: GOOD)</span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><b><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><b><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE DAY
REPORT</span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><b><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RAILS WERE PLACED AT ORIGINAL POSITION
FROM 1400 METRES TO 1200 METRES, 2 METRES WIDE AT 1000 METRES, THEREAFTER 4
METRES WIDE UP TO THE WINNING POST. RAILS WERE PLACED 4 METRES WIDE IN THE
CHUTE.</span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:
11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.1 (1) – THE SEASON
OPENER PLATE<span class=GramE>  -</span> DIVISION I: (ABOUT) 1000 METRES –
RUNNERS - 11</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ENSKY (<span class=SpellE>Amyn</span>
Merchant, dr.3) was slow to begin and lost about two lengths at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>PALOMA (<span class=SpellE>Suraj</span>
<span class=SpellE>Narredu</span>, dr.4) lost about a length at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>At the start, SANTANA ROW (App. <span
class=SpellE>Ramswarup</span>, dr.2) jumped outwards and had to be steadied.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Soon after the start, ARBITRAGE
(App. <span class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore) leaned outwards at the same time
ABSOLUTE EMPEROR (P. S. <span class=SpellE>Kaviraj</span>) leaned inwards
thereby bumping and tightening HOUSE OF LORDS (App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>). Jockey P. S. <span class=SpellE>Kaviraj</span>
and App. <span class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore have been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 900 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, HOUSE OF LORDS (App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>) shifted in and went across ARBITRAGE (App. <span
class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore) causing the latter to be checked. App. <span
class=SpellE>Avinash</span> <span class=SpellE>Paswan</span> has been
cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 800 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, PALOMA (<span class=SpellE>Suraj</span> <span
class=SpellE>Narredu</span>) racing along the rails was tightened for room and
had to be steadied. </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 150 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, HOUSE OF LORDS (App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>) leaned in onto ZALIA (App. Bharat Singh) who
in turn shifted in thereby tightening and inconveniencing ARBITRAGE (App. <span
class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore), causing the latter to be checked. After
questioning and not being satisfied with the explanation, App. <span
class=SpellE>Avinash</span> <span class=SpellE>Paswan</span> has been fined
Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 100 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, ENSKY (<span class=SpellE>Amyn</span> Merchant)
shifted in under urgings and went across KEY WEST (<span class=SpellE>Prashant</span>
P. <span class=SpellE>Dhebe</span>) causing the latter to be checked. After
questioning and not being satisfied with the explanation, Jockey <span
class=SpellE>Amyn</span> Merchant has been fined Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>MARCUS (K. <span class=SpellE>Nazil</span>)
was observed to have trailed the field. Trainer <span class=SpellE>Narendra</span>
<span class=SpellE>Lagad</span> has been asked to ensure that his charge puts
up a reasonable performance in the future.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After the race, the Veterinary
Officer reported the following:</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ENSKY was observed to have an
injury on its left hind pastern.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>MARCUS was trotted and found to be
sound and was observed to have a gum injury.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ARBITRAGE was observed to have an
injury on its left hind pastern.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>SANTANA ROW was observed to have
an injury on its right hind tendon.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:
11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.2 (2) – THE DR. S.
R. CAPTAIN SALVER: (ABOUT) 1400 METRES – RUNNERS - 5</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Passing the 1300 meters, MARKET
KING (C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>) racing on the haunches of IRISH
GOLD (P. Trevor) was observed to have clipped the former and stumbled.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 1100 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, WESTERN STAR (Antony Raj S.) leaned inwards thereby
tightening and inconveniencing IRISH GOLD (P. Trevor) causing the latter to be
checked. Jockey Antony Raj S. has been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Passing the 700 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, SOVEREIGN KING (A. <span class=SpellE>Sandesh</span>)
leaned inwards onto IRISH GOLD (P. Trevor) who in turn shifted in thereby
tightening and inconveniencing KAVYA (N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>)
causing the latter to be checked. After questioning and not being satisfied
with the explanation, Jockey A. <span class=SpellE>Sandesh</span> has been
fined Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 300 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, KAVYA (N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>)
racing along the rails was tightened for room, had to check and change course.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=right style='text-align:right'><b><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Jockey A. <span class=SpellE>Sandesh</span>
(SOVEREIGN KING) was observed to have used the whip in an excess of the
prescribed limit on his mount. This being his first offence during the current <span
class=SpellE>Pune</span> Meeting 2026, he has been fined Rs.3<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>An enquiry has been initiated
into the running and riding of KAVYA (N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>)
and a report will be submitted shortly.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After the race, the Veterinary
Officer reported the following:</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>IRISH GOLD was observed to have
an injury on its left hind medial side tibia.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:
11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.3 (3) – THE SEASON
OPENER PLATE<span class=GramE>  -</span> DIVISION II: (ABOUT) 1000 METRES
– RUNNERS - 10</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>LUCKY DIAMOND
(C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>, dr.1) was observed to have taken a fly
jump throwing its head up as the start was <span class=GramE>effected</span>.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>PRECIOSO (T. S. <span
class=SpellE>Jodha</span>, dr.3) threw its head up and lost about a length at
the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>RED MERLOT (App.
<span class=SpellE>Avinash</span> <span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>, dr.6) threw
its head up at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>FLASH MOB (<span
class=SpellE>Amyn</span> Merchant, dr.4) threw its head up and jumped out awkwardly
at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>At the start,
KAJO (<span class=SpellE>Shrikant</span> <span class=SpellE>Kamble</span>,
dr.8) jumped inwards at the same time RED MERLOT (App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>, dr.6) jumped outwards throwing its head up
thereby bumping and tightening CRIMSON PIRATE (D. R. <span class=SpellE>Shubham</span>,
dr.7).</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>Soon after the
start, MAJESTIC WARRIOR (J. <span class=SpellE>Chinoy</span>) shifted out under
urgings thereby bumping and unbalancing CRIMSON PIRATE (D. R. <span
class=SpellE>Shuhham</span>) who in turn shifted out thereby bumping and
unbalancing FLASHMAN (App. A. .<span class=SpellE>Omkar</span>) as a result
STARIA (P. Trevor) racing on their outside was carried outwards, due to this
incident KAJO (<span class=SpellE>Shrikant</span> <span class=SpellE>Kamble</span>)
racing on the haunches of CRIMOSN PIRATE had to be checked.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;line-height:120%'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;line-height:120%;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'>An objection was lodged by Jockey D. R. <span class=SpellE>Shubham</span>
rider of CRIMSON PIRATE placed 4<sup>th</sup> by the Judge against Jockey J. <span
class=SpellE>Chinoy</span> rider of MAJESTIC WARRIOR placed 3<sup>rd</sup> by
the Judge, reason being, “after the jump out MAJESTIC WARRIOR came onto him due
to which he got unbalanced and thereafter his horse did not come into stride
and only came into stride for last 2 furlongs. Due to this incident he lost a
certain position”.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;line-height:120%'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;line-height:120%;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After considering the submissions
made by the Jockeys concerned, in conjunction with the Stipendiary Stewards and
relying on their own observations of the race, the Stewards decided to overrule
the objection. However, they found Jockey J. <span class=SpellE>Chinoy</span>
guilty of careless riding on his mount MAJESTIC WARRIOR. Due to lack of quorum
the consideration of this item has been deferred.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;

(App. A. <span class=SpellE>Omkar</span>) out. App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span> has been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;

<span class=SpellE>Kamble</span> was observed to have used the whip in an

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>STARIA was

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:
11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.4 (4) – THE
COLUMBIA PLATE: (ABOUT) 1200 METRES – RUNNERS - 12</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>On the way to the starting gates,
NEUTRALIST (P. Trevor) dislodged the rider and bolted, subsequently the colt
was apprehended at about the 200 <span class=SpellE>metres</span> marker and
with the consent of Trainer <span class=SpellE>Aman</span> <span class=SpellE>Altaf</span>
<span class=SpellE>Hussain</span> the colt was withdrawn before coming under
the Starter’s order. As such, Trainer <span class=SpellE>Aman</span> <span
class=SpellE>Altaf</span> <span class=SpellE>Hussain</span> has been asked to
take remedial measures, before next accepting to race.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After being stalled, ADMIRABLE
(App. <span class=SpellE>Ramswarup</span>, dr.3) reared up in the stall and sat
down, as such, the filly was taken out and examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O., who
certified her fit to race. Trainer P. S. <span class=SpellE>Chouhan</span> has
been asked to give his charge more gate practice and show the filly to the
satisfaction of the Starter at morning starting trials, before next accepting
to race.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>DESERT CLASSIC (K. <span
class=SpellE>Pranil</span>, dr.2) was observed to have thrown its head up as
the start was affected.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>STORMY SEA (N. S. <span
class=SpellE>Parmar</span>, dr.9) lost about a length at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>At the start, HEAVEN’S RHYTHM (A.
S. Peter, dr.1) jumped outwards and made contact with DESERT CLASSIC (K. <span
class=SpellE>Pranil</span>, dr.2).</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>At the start, EL MORAN (C. S. <span
class=SpellE>Jodha</span>, dr.7) jumped outwards thereby bumping and forcing
CINDERELLA’S DREAM (<span class=SpellE>Amyn</span> Merchant, dr.8) outwards
onto STORMY SEA (N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>, dr.9). Jockey C. S. <span
class=SpellE>Jodha</span> has been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>At the start, STORM CLOUD (App. <span
class=SpellE>Avinash</span> <span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>, dr.10) jumped
outwards and made contact with MANOR HOUSE (<span class=SpellE>Akshay</span> <span
class=SpellE>Gaikwad</span>, dr.11) at the same time ASHWA GYPSY (App. <span
class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore, dr.12) leaned inwards thereby further
tightening and inconveniencing MANOR HOUSE. App. <span class=SpellE>Avinash</span>
<span class=SpellE>Paswan</span> and <span class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore
have been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal align=center style='text-align:center'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 1000 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, ASHWA BRAZIL (App. S. <span class=SpellE>Siddharth</span>)
shifted in and went across DESERT CLASSIC (K. <span class=SpellE>Pranil</span>)
causing the latter to be checked. App. S. <span class=SpellE>Siddharth</span>
has been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 800 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, EL MORAN (C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>)
leaned in and went across ASHWA BRAZIL (App. S. <span class=SpellE>Siddharth</span>)
causing the latter to be checked. After questioning and not being satisfied
with the explanation, Jockey C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span> has been
fined Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 800 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, Jockey <span class=SpellE>Akshay</span> <span
class=SpellE>Gaikwad</span> (MANOR HOUSE) leaned inwards onto STORM CLOUD (App.
<span class=SpellE>Avinash</span> <span class=SpellE>Paswan</span>) who in turn
shifted in thereby tightening and inconveniencing ADMIRABLE (App. <span
class=SpellE>Ramswarup</span>) racing along the rails causing the latter to be
checked. Thereafter Jockey <span class=SpellE>Akshay</span> <span class=SpellE>Gaikwad</span>
(MANOR HOUSE) was inclined inwards thereby bumping and tightening STORM CLOUD
on more than one occasion. It was also observed that passing the 300 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span>, MANOR HOUSE shifted in thereby bumping and
tightening EL MORAN (C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>). After questioning
and not being satisfied with the explanation, Jockey <span class=SpellE>Akshay</span>
<span class=SpellE>Gaikwad</span> has been fined Rs.3<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Passing the 700 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span> STORMY SEA (N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>)
leaned inwards thereby tightening and inconveniencing ASHWA GYPSY (App. <span
class=SpellE>Haridas</span> Gore) who had to be checked. After questioning and
not being satisfied with the explanation, Jockey N. S. <span class=SpellE>Parmar</span>
has been fined Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/-.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'>Approaching the 600 <span class=SpellE>metres</span>, SKANDHA (T.
S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>) racing along the rails was tightened for
room and had to be checked.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal><span style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";
color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Approaching the 300 <span
class=SpellE>metres</span> ADMIRABLE (App. <span class=SpellE>Ramswarup</span>)
shifted out onto SKANDHA (T. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>) who had to be
steadied thereafter ADMIRABLE leaned inwards thereby tightening and inconveniencing
EL MORAN (C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span><span class=GramE>) causing</span>
the latter to be checked. After the race on questioning App. <span
class=SpellE>Ramswarup</span> stated that his saddle had slipped and shifted to
one side during the race, as such, he was unable to exercise proper control
over his mount.  In view of this Trainer P. S. <span class=SpellE>Chouhan</span>
has been fined Rs.2<span class=GramE>,000</span>/- being the first instance of
faulty saddling during the current <span class=SpellE>Pune</span> Meeting 2026.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After the race, the Veterinary
Officer reported the following:</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ADMIRABLE was trotted and found
to be sound.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>ASHWA GYPSY was observed to have
an injury on its left hind bulb of heel.</span></p>

color:black'> </span></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span

background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'>COME SEPTEMBER (<span class=SpellE>Akshay</span> Kumar, dr.9)

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'>Approaching the 100 <span class=SpellE>metres</span>, BRIGHT
BUTTON (C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>) shifted out under urgings and

C. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span> has been cautioned.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>After the race,
the Veterinary Officer reported the following:</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>COME SEPTEMBER
was examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. and was found to be sore by right fore. As such,
the mare has to be passed fit by the Club’s V.O., before next accepting to
race.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'>MOONLIGHT KISS was observed to have a tongue injury.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><b><u><span style='font-size:
11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.6 (6) – THE
CERTAINTY PLATE: (ABOUT) 1200 METRES – RUNNERS - 8</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'>On a request from Trainer <span class=SpellE>Adhirajsingh</span>
<span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>, GONZALO was permitted to be withdrawn on
compassionate grounds.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify;background:white'><span
style='font-size:11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;
background:white'>On a request from Trainer <span class=SpellE>Nazzak</span> B.
<span class=SpellE>Chenoy</span>, MAGENTA was permitted to be withdrawn on
compassionate grounds.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>TEMPO (T. S. <span class=SpellE>Jodha</span>,
dr.1) was observed to have jumped out throwing its head up at the start.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>At the start, AVANTE (A. <span
class=SpellE>Sandesh</span>, dr.10) jumped out awkwardly and was observed to

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>Soon after the start, INVINCIBLE

Merchant).</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After the race, Jockeys <span
class=SpellE>Suraj</span> <span class=SpellE>Narredu</span> (INVINCIBLE FORCE)
and A. <span class=SpellE>Sandesh</span> (AVANTE) reported that their
respective mounts were running green.</span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>After the race, Jockey P. Trevor

11.0pt;font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'>RACE NO.7 (7) – THE
ELEGANCE PLATE: (ABOUT) 1200 METRES – RUNNERS - 8</span></u></b></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

<p class=MsoNormal style='text-align:justify'><span style='font-size:11.0pt;
font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>On arrival at
the starting gates, on a request from Jockey P. Trevor, TRAIL BLAZER was

Chief Stipendiary Steward due <span class=SpellE>weightage</span> was given to
apprehension raised by the Jockey P. Trevor and the colt was permitted to be
withdrawn before coming under the Starters order. Subsequently, the colt was again
examined by the Club’s Sr. V.O. on 18<sup>th</sup> July 2026 and found to have
sore back. However, the colt was trotted sound.</span></p>

font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'> </span></p>

dr.8) took a fly jump at the start.</span></p>

font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black'> </span></p>

font-family:"Arial","sans-serif";color:black;background:white'>At the start,

and Jockey J. <span class=SpellE>Chinoy</span> have been cautioned.</span></p>
